days.name: Coach Log / Upper
days.note: Keep the rest of this session exactly as your coach prescribed. These are the competition-lift anchors we are carrying forward.

exercises.name: Competition Log C&P
exercises.note: Full clean and press. Do not add weight because it feels good.

exercises.name: Log Back-off
exercises.note: Quality volume; finish with reps in reserve.

warmup.name: Raise temperature
warmup.note: Easy pace. Finish warm, not tired.

warmup.name: Banded lat stretch
warmup.note: Gentle hold; breathe into the ribcage.

warmup.name: Bench T-spine extension
warmup.note: Keep ribs controlled; open through the upper back.

warmup.name: Band shoulder pass-throughs
warmup.note: Smooth range, no forcing.

warmup.name: Face pull + external rotation
warmup.note: Prime upper back and rotator cuff.

warmup.name: Log ramp-up
warmup.note: The empty log is 80 kg. No loaded log warm-up below 80 kg; use the movement-prep drills before this.

cardio.name: Zone 2 bike / incline walk
cardio.note: Optional this handover week; do not interfere with your coach's work.

days.name: Coach Deadlift / Back
days.note: Keep the rest of this session exactly as your coach prescribed.

exercises.name: Competition Deadlift
exercises.note: This is our baseline top set.

warmup.name: Raise temperature
warmup.note: Easy pace.

warmup.name: Half-kneeling hip-flexor stretch
warmup.note: Glute squeezed; avoid arching the lower back.

warmup.name: Adductor rock-back
warmup.note: Controlled range; keep spine neutral.

warmup.name: Hamstring floss
warmup.note: Move in and out of range rather than holding a deep stretch.

warmup.name: Dead bug + hard brace
warmup.note: Full exhale, then 360° brace.

warmup.name: Deadlift ramp-up
warmup.note: These are warm-up sets, not work sets. Add a small intermediate jump if anything feels stiff.

days.name: Coach Leg Day
days.note: Follow your coach’s existing leg session this week.

warmup.name: Raise temperature
warmup.note: Easy pace.

warmup.name: Knee-over-toe ankle rocks
warmup.note: Heel stays down.

warmup.name: Couch / hip-flexor stretch
warmup.note: Short relaxed holds only before lifting.

warmup.name: 90/90 hip switches
warmup.note: Move slowly through the hips.

warmup.name: Adductor rock-back
warmup.note: Controlled range.

warmup.name: Goblet squat pry
warmup.note: Sit into position, breathe, then stand explosively.

days.name: Saturday Strongman Technique / Support
days.note: Mixed, low-fatigue strongman session. Log gets one focused technique exposure for leg drive; then a light deadlift exposure, carries/loading and support work. Nothing should compromise the start of Week 1.

warmup.name: Raise temperature
warmup.note: Finish warm, not tired.

warmup.name: World's greatest stretch
warmup.note: Flow through the positions; do not force range.

warmup.name: Half-kneeling hip-flexor stretch
warmup.note: Glute squeezed; keep ribs down so the hips can extend hard.

warmup.name: Bench T-spine extension
warmup.note: Open the upper back without flaring the ribs.

warmup.name: Band shoulder pass-throughs
warmup.note: Smooth, pain-free range.

warmup.name: Bodyweight jump primer
warmup.note: Maximal intent with full recovery. Reinforce dip → violent extension.

warmup.name: Empty log rehearsal
warmup.prescription: 80 × 1 rehearsal single, then begin the programmed singles
warmup.note: The log itself is 80 kg. Stand tall, brace, short vertical dip, legs initiate the drive.

warmup.name: Deadlift hinge reset
warmup.note: Brace, push hips back, keep lats on before the paused pulls.

exercises.name: Competition Log — Leg-Drive Technique Singles
exercises.note: Full clean and press every rep. Settle tall in the rack, brace, short vertical dip, drive hard through the whole foot, then let the arms finish. The goal is timing and force transfer, not fatigue.

exercises.name: Paused Deadlift
exercises.note: Pause just off the floor, maintain position, then accelerate. This is technical support work, not a second heavy deadlift day.

exercises.name: Farmers / Frame Carry
exercises.note: Moderate load. Fast pick, tall posture and controlled speed. Leave plenty in reserve.

exercises.name: Sandbag Bear-Hug Carry / Load
exercises.note: Use whichever sandbag setup is available. Smooth picks and bracing; no maximal bag work.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.note: Upper-back volume without taxing the lower back.

exercises.name: Dead Bug / 360° Brace
exercises.note: Hard exhale, brace, then move without losing rib/pelvis position.

cardio.name: Easy bike / incline walk
cardio.note: Easy cooldown. The carries already provide some conditioning, so keep this genuinely easy.
